<b>Mitemothers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are female [[Mites]] that have grown especially large and powerful with age.<ref>[[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>Aged female mite, grown larger and stronger than most of its kin.</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Mitemothers generally hop back and forth across a flat area, turning around upon reaching the edge. When one spots Hornet, it screams, then hops towards her at greater speed. It deals {{Damage|2}} upon contact.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Mitemothers have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin
| columns = 2|
* Screech and smash them...
* Rip and rend...
* Raise the many...
* Darker, quieter... more...
}}

== Location ==
Mitemothers can be found in [[Greymoor]], in a room southwest of the [[Bellway]] station.
